info.title: bConnect Endpoints API
info.description: Endpoints are the main objects within the baramundi Management Suite (see documentation). These can be manually created or automatically discovered by network scans or via Active Directory synchronization. The methods offered here provide support for manual creation of endpoints and their enrollment. Afterwards the endpoints are ready to be managed by the baramundi Management Suite and jobs can be distributed to these endpoints to gather information or execute logic for the various modules of the baramundi Management Suite (e.g. Compliance, Defense Control, Update Management, etc.).

get.summary: Gets the maintenance window of the endpoint

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint. Only windows endpoints are supported at the moment.

200.description: Returns the maintenance window associated with the specified endpoint.

404.description: An endpoint with the specified ID does not exist.

409.description: The endpoint with the specified ID has no maintenance window.

post.summary: Creates a maintenance window for the endpoint

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint. Only windows endpoints are supported at the moment.

requestBody.description: The maintenance window to be created. Maintenance windows are defined in respect to the local time of a client. Start and end of a maintenance period are defined using a 24-hour clock in intervals of 15 minutes (e.g. 00:00, 00:15, 17:45, 24:00).

201.description: The maintenance window was created as requested and can be seen in the body of the response.

403.description: The user does not have the necessary permission to modify the endpoint in order to create a maintenance window.

404.description: There is no endpoint with the specified ID.

409.description: A maintenance window already exists for the endpoint.

put.summary: Updates the maintenance window of the endpoint

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint. Only windows endpoints are supported at the moment.

requestBody.description: Contents which the existing maintenance window will be overwritten with. Maintenance windows are defined in respect to the local time of a client. Start and end of a maintenance period are defined using a 24-hour clock in intervals of 15 minutes (e.g. 00:00, 00:15, 17:45, 24:00).

200.description: The maintenance window was updated as requested and can be seen in the body of the response.

403.description: The user does not have the necessary permission to modify the endpoint in order to update the maintenance window.

404.description: An endpoint with the specified ID does not exist.

409.description: The endpoint with the specified ID has no maintenance window.

delete.summary: Deletes the maintenance window of the endpoint

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint. Only windows endpoints are supported at the moment.

204.description: The maintenance window was successfully deleted or does not exist.

403.description: The user does not have the necessary permission to modify the endpoint in order to delete the maintenance window.

404.description: An endpoint with the specified ID does not exist.
